summary: The Goshen Township Board of Trustees held a regular meeting covering a wide range of business including approval of a major PUD modification for Lakefield Place, adoption of the Clermont County Hazard Mitigation Plan, nine zoning violation enforcement referrals to the county prosecutor, personnel actions including hiring four part-time firefighter EMTs, and equipment purchases for the fire department. The board also discussed cemetery trash can upgrades, drainage improvements behind the administration building, removal of Flock cameras from the strategic plan, and road paving plans.

notes: Meeting adjourned at 7:49 PM. Executive session held from 7:26 to approximately 7:45 PM regarding personnel matters. The Quint fire apparatus was viewed in Kentucky. Police department's state accreditation is a new program through the State of Ohio. Jim Poe from the Historical Society discussed hosting descendants of baseball player Sam Lieber (Sam Leever) and a potential historic district designation behind the Anchorage. The Flock camera removal from the strategic plan was driven by recent public controversy despite having already received a grant for them. The tornado siren discussion included references to tornado alley shifting eastward and local tornado activity. Mobilecom is in disputes with local 911 systems over tower equipment upgrade costs. The transcript had significant audio quality issues in multiple sections.
